_draft: Somali: machine-assisted draft – needs native reader check
start: Salaan. Waxaan ka jawaabaa su'aalaha casharkaaga ALX, kaliya koorsada, oo leh xiriir qaybta aan isticmaalay. Qor, hadal, ama isticmaal badhamada hoose. /help wuxuu muujinayaa amar kasta.
consentAsk: Si aan uga jawaabo, su'aashaada waxaan u diri karaa adeeg AI ah oo internetka ah. Wax ku saabsan cidda aad tahay lama diro. Fariimaha codka sidoo kale waxay u baahan yihiin adeeg internet.
consentSaved: Waa la keydiyay. Waxaad ku beddeli kartaa /consent.
notFound: Tan kama helin koorsada. Dir /person si aad qof ula hadasho.
noAdvice: Ma bixin karo talo caafimaad, sharci ama socdaal. Dir /person si aad qof ula hadasho.
voiceNeedsConsent: Codku wuxuu u baahan yahay ka shaqeyn internet. Qor su'aashaada, ama ku oggolow jawaabaha internetka /start.
voiceFailed: Ma fahmin fariinta codka. Fadlan qor, ama isku day mar kale si tartiib ah.
voiceTooLong: Fariintan codku aad bay u dheer tahay. Dir mid ka yar 20 MB, ama qor su'aashaada.
helpOnline: Macallin ayaa soo socda. Jawaabtiisu halkan ayay imaan doontaa. Lambarka codsiga: {id}
helpLater: Macallin ayaa halkan kaaga jawaabi doona. Waxay qaadan kartaa ilaa subaxa. Lambarka codsiga: {id}
ticketLinked: Waa la sameeyay. Jawaabta macallinka ee codsiga {id} sidoo kale halkan ayay imaan doontaa.
alertsUsage: Dir /alerts iyo eray, tusaale: /alerts accountant Addis Ababa
alertsOn: Ogeysiisyada waa shidan yihiin “{keyword}”. Dir /stop si aad u joojiso.
stopped: Dhammaan ogeysiisyada shaqada waa la joojiyay.
apiDown: Adeegga hadda lama gaari karo. Fadlan isku day mar dambe.
error: Waan ka xumahay, wax baa khaldamay. Fadlan isku day mar kale, ama dir /person si aad qof ula hadasho.
menuReady: Liisku waa hoos. Sidoo kale waad qori kartaa ama hadli kartaa.
helpText:
Waxa aan qaban karo:
/ask – weydii casharka (ama kaliya qor ama hadal)
/lesson – qaybaha casharka
/person – la hadal qof
/status – codsigaaga iyo jawaabtii ugu dambeysay
/jobs – raadi shaqooyin tijaabo ah
/alerts – ogeysiisyada shaqada, /myalerts – ogeysiisyadaada, /stop – jooji ogeysiisyada
/accommodate – codso taageero wareysi
/lang – luqadda, /simple – jawaabo fudud, /voice – jawaabo cod ah
/mydata – waxa la keydiyay, /delete – tirtir
Sidoo kale waad dhihi kartaa ama qori kartaa erayada, tusaale “cashar” ama “la hadal qof”.
askPrompt: Qor ama dheh su'aashaada ku saabsan casharka.
lessonPick: Dooro qayb casharka ka mid ah:
lessonEmpty: Weli ma jiro waxyaabo cashar ah.
simpleOn: Jawaabaha fudud waa shidan yihiin: weedho gaaban oo cad.
voiceOn: Jawaabaha codka waa shidan yihiin. Jawaabaha sidoo kale waxay u imaanayaan fariin cod ah.
voiceOff: Jawaabaha codka waa demsan yihiin. Jawaabaha waxay u imaanayaan qoraal kaliya.
statusNone: Ma haysatid codsi furan. Dir /person si aad qof ula hadasho.
statusNoReply: Weli jawaab ma jirto. Macallin ayaa halkan kaaga jawaabi doona.
jobsUsage: Dir /jobs iyo eray, tusaale: /jobs accountant. Shaqooyinka tijaabada ee furan:
jobsNone: Ma jiraan shaqooyin furan oo ku habboon “{keyword}”. Dir /alerts {keyword} si laguugu sheego kuwa cusub.
jobsTrust: Xog tijaabo ah oo kaliya. Ka hubi bogga loo-shaqeeyaha. Waligaa lacag ha bixin si aad u codsato.
myalertsNone: Ma haysatid ogeysiisyo shaqo. Dir /alerts iyo eray si aad mid ugu darto.
myalertsHeader: Ogeysiisyadaada shaqada. Taabo mid si aad u joojiso:
accPickJob: Taageerada wareysiga waxay u socotaa caawiye shaqo, ee ma aha si toos ah loo-shaqeeyaha. Shaqadee bay u tahay?
accNoJobs: Ma jiraan shaqooyin furan oo laga doorto.
accNeeds: Taageero noocee ah ayaad u baahan tahay? Taabo kuwa ku habboon oo dhan, kadibna Dhammee. Uma baahnid inaad sharaxdo sababta.
accChooseOne: Fadlan dooro ugu yaraan hal nooc oo taageero ah.
accNote: U dir caawiyaha shaqada qoraal gaaban, ama taabo Ka bood.
accSent: Waa la diray. Caawiye shaqo ayaa halkan kugula soo xiriiri doona. Codsigaagu wuxuu u socdaa qof, ee ma aha loo-shaqeeyaha.
mydataText: Waa kan wax kasta oo laga keydiyay wada-hadalkan.
deleteConfirm: Tirtir wax kasta oo laga keydiyay wada-hadalkan (ogeysiisyada, codsiyada, wada-hadalka, luqadda)? Tan dib looma celin karo.
deleteDone: Waa la tirtiray. Dir /start si aad mar kale u bilowdo.
cmd_voice: Jawaabo cod ah shid ama dami
voiceUnavailable: Jawaabtan ma samayn karin fariin cod ah. Waxaa lagu muujiyay qoraal.
